column28: We democratize AI by enabling AI companies to train, finetune, and inference their AI models for ~3 times cheaper then elsewhere using our global distributed AI compute clusters.
column29: We are building a marketplace for distributed AI training, finetuning, and inference without the need to purchase hardware, rent a datacenter, or be in a specific region/location.   On a supply side, anyone with an idle GPU (miners, gamers) supply their compute for a fee. The fee covers their electricity cost + margin on top. Gamers have 8GB+ GPUs that are used max 8 hours/day while remaining 16 hours this resource is under-utilized/idle. Miners have GPU rigs that are also idle given it’s unprofitable to mine crypto. We take these GPUs, assemble them into giant compute clusters, install our framework onto it and provide it as a AI training, finetuning, inference infrastructure.  On a demand side,  these private distributed compute clusters are provided to companies in need of AI training, finetuning or making an inference. We estimate to price to be multiple times cheaper (~3x) then AWS, LambdaLab, and similar providers. Additionally, current providers supply a bare-bone GPU infrastructure with nothing on top while we provide custom architecture and deploy the architecture automatically for the customer.
